_comment: OpenSTA oracle reference numbers for issue #809's spike, captured 2026-08-12. See README.md for how these were produced and how to reproduce them. Every path listed is the design's GLOBAL worst path (max over every startpoint/endpoint pair), verified by report_checks -group_path_count with no -from/-to restriction, then re-queried with an explicit -from/-to for the exact per-hop breakdown quoted below.

toolchain.engine: OpenSTA, originally captured via OpenROAD's embedded copy
toolchain.cross_check: These exact numbers (4.5250 / 4.0100 / 7.3700 ns) were independently reproduced against the standalone `openroad/opensta:latest` build (OpenSTA 3.1.0, entrypoint OpenSTA/build/sta), with no LEF mounted. The prior claim that no standalone OpenSTA binary exists was wrong -- see README.md's 'Reproducing the OpenSTA oracle numbers' correction note.

boundary_condition.note: set_input_transition 0.05 [all_inputs]; set_load 0.03 [all_outputs]; no create_clock (report_checks -unconstrained), matching this repo's own abc -constr measurement convention (docs/design/synthesize-qor-improvements-survey.md section 1.3) adapted to OpenSTA's SDC surface.

gcd.note: a register feeding its own next-state logic (self-loop through combinational logic, not a combinational cycle)
